listings.title: The Space Families Need, The Outdoor Lifestyle They'll Love
listings.description: THE PROPERTY Offering the space families need and the lifestyle they love, this immaculately presented home creates an instant sense of comfort from the moment you arrive. Surrounded by beautifully maintained gardens, it delivers the perfect balance of indoor warmth, outdoor enjoyment and move-in-ready convenience. At its heart, the spacious open-plan living, dining and kitchen zone provides a light-filled hub for everyday life, where polished timber floors, large windows and leafy garden outlooks create a welcoming atmosphere. The well-appointed kitchen offers quality appliances, excellent storage and plenty of room for family meals, casual catch-ups and entertaining with friends. Three generous bedrooms with built-in robes and split-system air conditioning provide comfortable accommodation, including a spacious main bedroom with a large built-in robe. The beautifully renovated bathroom is highlighted by a stunning freestanding bath and separate shower, creating the perfect place to relax and unwind. Stepping outside reveals the true hero of the property, with a huge entertaining deck overlooking an expansive backyard where children can run freely, pets can play and family gatherings can continue long into the evening. Complete with established gardens, a paved sitting area, large shed, LED lighting and ample off-street parking, this move-in-ready home presents an exceptional lifestyle opportunity in a highly sought-after location close to schools, shopping, transport and parklands. THE FEATURES Immaculately presented and move-in ready Three bedrooms with built-in robes Split-system air conditioning throughout Light-filled open-plan living and dining zone Beautiful bathroom with freestanding bath Expansive entertaining deck overlooking backyard Huge backyard with shed and established gardens THE LOCATION Enjoy a lifestyle where everyday convenience and family-friendly living go hand in hand. Zoned to Mountain Gate Primary School and Fairhills High School, the home is ideally positioned for growing families seeking quality education options close to home. Ferntree Gully Train Station is moments away for effortless commuting, while Westfield Knox offers an outstanding selection of shopping, dining, cafés and entertainment. listings.description: This beautifully recently renovated single-level apartment is now available for lease in one of Glen Iris most desirable and convenient locations. Offering generous space, modern finishes, and a quiet setting, it's ideal for seeking comfort, style, and easy access to everything. Freshly updated throughout, the home features brand-new tiled flooring, plush carpets in the living area and bedrooms, and a full interior repaint. The newly installed kitchen impresses with sleek benchtops and quality fittings, while the sparkling new bathroom and updated laundry provide added convenience and style. Natural light floods the spacious lounge and dining area, creating a warm and inviting living space. Two well-proportioned bedrooms each come with built-in robes, plenty of storage space to keep your life organized and stress-free and the property includes a secure car space in a lock-up garage - a rare find in this location Perfectly positioned within walking distance to Gardiner Station, High Street and Malvern Road trams, local shops, cafés, parks, prestigious schools, the Harold Holt Swim Centre, and with quick access to the M1 Freeway. FEATURES INCLUDE: - 2 bedrooms with built in robes - Living room with extra storage space - Extra large living area - New kitchen with dishwasher and branded appliances - Renovated bathroom with bathtub and shower - Separate toilet - Separate upgraded laundry - Ducted heating - Split system - Bedrooms ceiling fans - undercover secure parking area, and access to common property parking
